stem.text: A wire has both elastic and plastic properties. When it is slowly loaded, its extension varies with load as shown by line OXY. The removal of the load is represented by line YZ. This creates areas P, Q and R on the graph.

stem.alt: Graph of load on the vertical axis against extension on the horizontal axis. Line OXY rises from the origin to a point Y and curves at the top; line YZ falls from Y back to a point Z on the extension axis. Areas labelled P, Q and R are shown; line OXY, X, Y and Z are labelled.

stem.text: Which area represents the maximum elastic potential energy stored in the wire?
